ImageDescription.value: U.S. Marines with Task Force 61/2.5 (Force Reconnaissance Company), conduct an amphibious landing during Formidable Shield in Andoya, Norway on May 9, 2023. Formidable Shield is a biennial, integrated air and missile defense (IAMD) exercise involving a series of live-fire events against subsonic, supersonic, and ballistic targets, incorporating multiple Allied ships, aircraft, and ground forces working across battlespaces to deliver effects.
